question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Budding'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the context **of the sentence, a "budding" reader refers to a child who is in the early stages of developing their reading skills.
 
• The word **"budding" **implies growth, progress, and potential, suggesting that the child is just starting to explore and develop their reading abilities.
 
• **By using the term** "budding reader," the **sentence conveys** the idea that the reader is at an early stage of their reading journey and is in the process of developing their reading skills.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Children learn to walk and talk naturally, (1) but that is not the case with reading. Reading strategies are designed to help your child develop a strong reading (2) foundation one built with confidence engagement and joy. As a parent, you are most likely always looking for (3) techniques that make your child want to learn. We are here to help you and your child on their journey as a (4)budding reader. Try some reading strategy suggestions below for kids (5) _______ are beginning to read all the way to those reading advanced chapter books. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dying: **This option does not fit well in the sentence. "Dying" implies a decline or nearing the end, which does not convey the idea of a child developing their reading skills.
 
• **Ripened:** This option does not fit well in the sentence. "Ripened" typically refers to something that has reached its full development or maturity, which does not align with the idea of a child at an early stage of learning to read.
 
• **Sulking:** This option does not fit well in the sentence. "Sulking" refers to a mood or behavior characterized by being silent, withdrawn, or unhappy, which does not relate to the context of a child's reading journey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Budding - उभरता हुआ
 
• Dying - मर रहा
 
• Ripened - पका हुआ
 
• Sulking - मुँह फुलाना
